title: Dynamical Simulations of Schrödinger's Equation via Rank-Adaptive Tensor Decompositions
summary: We study low-rank tensor methods for the numerical solution of Schrödinger's equation with time-independent and explicitly time-dependent Hamiltonians, motivated by large-scale simulations of many-body quantum systems and quantum computing devices subject to time-dependent control pulses. We outline the recent application of the "basis update and Galerkin" (BUG) method for tensor trains, and describe the established TDVP and TDVP-2 algorithms based on the time-dependent variational principle.
